films.title: Resident Evil (2026)
films.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan finds himself caught in a night of escalating chaos and must fight to survive. Directed by Zach Cregger, this is a new story in the Resident Evil universe.

films.title: Tenzing
films.synopsis: The story of mountaineer Tenzing Norgay and his extraordinary journey to the summit of Everest alongside Edmund Hillary, exploring the determination and partnership behind their historic ascent.

films.title: The Love Hypothesis
films.synopsis: PhD candidate Olive enters a pretend relationship with intimidating professor Adam Carlsen. As their arrangement grows more complicated, the scientist discovers that real feelings do not follow a neat hypothesis.

films.title: 牛来 (Niu Lai)
films.synopsis: Niu Lai (2026) is a Mandarin-language animated feature from China, directed by Xin Yumeng and written by Sun Lifang.

films.title: The Shawshank Redemption
films.synopsis: Imprisoned banker Andy Dufresne forms a lasting friendship with fellow inmate Red. Across years inside Shawshank, their story explores perseverance, dignity and the power of hope.
